title: Falling: lives and revives
summary: What happens when you fall: in the city, in a dungeon (extra lives, elimination, the comeback for Robux) and in the Endless Tower.

blocks.text: You get up after 3 s , untouchable for 2 s.
blocks.html: You get up after 3 s, untouchable for 2 s.

blocks.text: On entering you get extra lives , rolled between 0 and a maximum that depends on the rift's rank (more in the low ranks). Fallen with a life left, you come back in the furthest room the party cleared (the entrance before that). Out of lives: ELIMINATED . You have 45 s to choose: watch the hunters still standing, leave, or come back for 39 R$ (once per dungeon). No choice: you leave. Once out, there is no way back into that same dungeon. A rift that collapses crushes everyone inside: back to the city. Not hurt once since you entered? You earn +5% XP in the dungeon while it lasts (the no-hit bonus).

blocks.text: You have 25 s to come back for 39 R$ (at most 3 times a run: back on the arena's spawn, the floor goes on) or leave (the run ends there). See the Endless Tower .

blocks.text: The comeback product: Extra Life (Revive) . Lives also change with the dungeon modifiers and dungeon events .
